name: Android Internal Recorder
description: Zero-lag hardware-accelerated internal video & FMOD audio recorder for Android.

resolution-scale.name: Resolution Scale
resolution-scale.description: 1.0 = Native screen resolution. Lower to 0.75 or 0.5 for zero lag on older GPUs.

target-fps.name: Recording FPS
target-fps.description: Target video framerate (30 or 60 recommended for smooth gameplay).

video-bitrate-mbps.name: Video Bitrate (Mbps)
video-bitrate-mbps.description: Higher = sharper quality, slightly higher storage write load.

use-hevc.name: Use H.265 (HEVC)
use-hevc.description: Better quality at lower bitrates on modern Android devices.

record-audio.name: Capture Internal FMOD Audio
record-audio.description: Records clean in-game music and SFX directly from FMOD.

show-overlay.name: Show Floating Record Button
show-overlay.description: Displays a small on-screen button to start/stop recording anywhere without pausing.

save-to-movies.name: Save to /sdcard/Movies
save-to-movies.description: Saves videos directly to your Gallery's Movies/GeometryDash folder (falls back to Geode folder if permission is denied).
